title: Ali Jaane Jahan
body:
ali ali ali ali maula ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
ali jaan e jahan
dil ye kehta hai tere ishq mai kho jaun ali
need aaye shab e hijrat si to so jaun ali
meri to rooh ne bhi teri hi bayyat ki hai
chod ke sara jahan bas tera ho jaun ali
<<DIVIDER>>
peeran e peer ali mera dastageer ali
jaan e jahan
aaqa e man ali maula e man ali
jaan e jahan
<<DIVIDER>>
sura e alhamd se sura e wan-naas tak
saare ke saare ali akbar o abbas tak
naad e ali padta ja gham na rahe paas tak
deen o emaan ali dil aur jaan ali
jaan e jahan
aaqa e man ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ye rauza tera noor ala noor hai
shehre najaf ki faza noor ala noor hai
aake yahan dil mera noor ala noor hai
tera deedar ali kar loon ek baar ali
jaan e jahan
aaqa e man ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
aql mein aata nahi ya ali ya ali
qalb se jaata nahi ya ali ya ali
tere siwa ya ali koi bhi bhaata nahi
tu banata hai mere kaam ali jaan e jahan
zindagi saari tere naam ali jaan e jahan
wird karta hoo subho shaam ali jaan e jahan
de mujhe ishq ka inaam ali jaan e jahan
jaan e jahan ali ali ali ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
peeran e peer ali mera dastageer ali
jaan e jahan
aaqa e man ali maula e man ali
jaan e jahan
<<DIVIDER>>
paaya hai phir usne kya jisne tujhe kho diya
khoya hai phir usne kya jisne tujhe paa liya
misle qalandar hua jis ne ye sauda kiya
tu hai wo raaz ali jo de parwaaz ali
jaan e jahan
aaqa e man ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai tere naukar
dil ke andar hai tera ghar
ye behrobar ye samandar
ye wali aur ye qalandar
kya faqeer aur kya tawangar
ya ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye seene mein halchal
mere har pal dil bole chal
mai najaf ko jaaun paidal
tay kar ke sehra aur jangal
bus tujh pe hi hai tawakkal
ya ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ali
hai tu hi rab ka wali maula ali
meri qismat ho bhali maula ali
ghoomon najaf ki gali ya ali maula ali
mai tera tu hai mera maula ali
dil mein tera basera maula ali
tu hai roshan sawera ya ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
tujh pe mera dil bhi fida
jism mera jaan bhi fida
jism o jaan ye dil hai kya ye rooh bhi fida
<<DIVIDER>>
peeran e peer ali mera dastageer ali
jaan e jahan
aaqa e man ali maula e man ali
jaan e jahan
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye jo mushkil koi hai ye wazeefa mera
hai yehi aadat meri hai ye wazeefa mera
paanch namazon mein bhi hai ye wazeefa mera
mera vakeel ali rab ki daleel ali
jaan e jahan
aaqa e man ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ali ali ali maila ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
daulat e dunya hai kya sirf ali chahiye
maine khuda se kaha sirf ali chahiye
mera lahoo bol utha sirf ali chahiye
khuld nahi ay khuda sirf ali chahiye
kuch nahi iske siwa sirf ali chahiye
kar de mujhe tu ata sirf ali chahiye
dil mein utaar ali bas ek baar ali
jaan e jahan
aaqa e man ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ali ali ali maila ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ne jaana nahi tujhko magar haye ali
rota tha tanhaiyon mein baith kar haye ali
roya kabhi qabr e sayyeda par haye ali
sajde mein zakhmi hua tera sar haye ali
karbobala mein luta tera ghar haye ali
bhoole na ahle aza haye ali haye ali
tujhpe hui jo jafa haye ali haye ali
pursa hai maula tujhe mazhar o farhan ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ya maktool ali ali
ya mazloom ali ali
ya mehroom ali ali
ya maula ali ali
ya hyder ali ali
ya rehbar ali ali
ya aaqa ali ali
ya maula ali ali
ya maula ali ali
author: Mazhar Abidi
